cameras.name: Rear Yard Camera
cameras.notes: Resolution must match the actual feed — building/zones.json and building/exits.json polygons are in this camera's image-space pixels and are not rescaled at runtime.

cameras.name: Second Camera (not yet configured)
cameras.notes: Demonstrates that the pipeline/API/frontend are genuinely multi-camera-capable (per-camera engine instances, incident state, and media routes), without fabricating a second camera's footage. `source` does not exist yet — resolution is null rather than guessed, and zones/exits are empty rather than copied from CAM-01 (which would be meaningless outside CAM-01's own pixel space). The pipeline skips this camera at runtime (logs why) until a real video is placed at `source` and its resolution/zones/exits are filled in for real. Every API this camera participates in reports its actual unavailable state — see backend/api/media.py and backend/api/incident.py — rather than substituting CAM-01's data.
